targets.name: Axeyum.Autogenesis.natHalfWitnessOfModTwoZeroV1
targets.statement: forall n : Nat, n % 2 = 0 -> exists q : Nat, n = q + q

proof_route: simultaneous structural parity development by zero/successor cases and two-step induction, reusing only the already clean target-owned modulo-two cases and successor-flip supports; no Nat.div, generic Even instance, simp, omega, or official parity proof
sequence: construct a parameterized residual if modulo recurrence leaves are still required
export both roots twice and audit independently
only then preregister their Int constructor lifts
stop_rule: If direct construction needs a new modulo recurrence law, fail closed and preregister that exact law rather than invoking automation.
limitations: Natural parity arithmetic is support only; integer lifting, Int.even_iff, the decision instance, and Fibonacci remain downstream.
